entries.title: Sun in Mesha
entries.body: The Sun is exalted in Mesha, most powerfully near 10°. Initiative, courage, leadership and vitality are at their peak. The fire sign of Mars gives decisive, pioneering self-expression. The shadow is impatience and a need always to be first.

entries.title: Sun in Vrishabha
entries.body: The Sun in Venus's fixed earth sign is in enemy territory by classical friendship. It gives steady, practical, pleasure-loving expression and determination. Authority is built through persistence and material security. Stubbornness is the caution.

entries.title: Sun in Mithuna
entries.body: The Sun in Mercury's dual air sign, a neutral relation, gives an intellectual, communicative and versatile identity. It suits writing, trade and learning. Focus can scatter across many interests.

entries.title: Sun in Karka
entries.body: The Sun in the Moon's water sign, a friendly sign, gives a sensitive, protective and family-centred sense of self. Leadership is expressed through care. Moods can colour confidence, and emotional security fuels purpose.

entries.title: Sun in Simha
entries.body: The Sun in its own sign, and its moolatrikona for most of it, is dignified and confident. It gives natural leadership, generosity and creative self-expression, and suits positions of authority. Pride and a need for recognition are the watch-points.

entries.title: Sun in Kanya
entries.body: The Sun in Mercury's earth sign is neutral. It gives an analytical, service-minded, detail-oriented self-expression with skill in health, accounts or crafts. Self-criticism should not dim the light.

entries.title: Sun in Tula
entries.body: The Sun is debilitated in Tula, deepest near 10°. Individual will is asked to yield to partnership and fairness. Confidence and relations with authority may need conscious work. Cancellation factors (neecha bhanga) can turn this into diplomatic strength.

entries.title: Sun in Vrishchika
entries.body: The Sun in Mars's fixed water sign is friendly. It gives an intense, determined, private and investigative character, strength in crises and interest in research or medicine. Control and secrecy need balance.

entries.title: Sun in Dhanu
entries.body: The Sun in Jupiter's fire sign is friendly. It gives principled, philosophical and generous self-expression and draws a person to teaching, law, religion or travel. Righteousness should not become preachiness.

entries.title: Sun in Makara
entries.body: The Sun in Saturn's earth sign is in an enemy sign. It gives disciplined, ambitious, pragmatic self-expression with authority earned slowly. Relations with the father or superiors can feel formal. Recognition comes through perseverance.

entries.title: Sun in Kumbha
entries.body: The Sun in Saturn's air sign is in an enemy sign. It gives humanitarian, unconventional, group-oriented ideals. Personal recognition may matter less than collective causes, and there can be friction with rigid authority.

entries.title: Sun in Meena
entries.body: The Sun in Jupiter's water sign is friendly. It gives a compassionate, imaginative and spiritual identity. Leadership comes through inspiration rather than command. Boundaries and practical focus need attention.

entries.title: Moon in Mesha
entries.body: The Moon in Mars's fire sign gives quick, enthusiastic, impulsive feelings. The heart is courageous and independent but can be impatient. Emotions flare and settle quickly, and physical activity steadies the mind.

entries.title: Moon in Vrishabha
entries.body: The Moon is exalted in Vrishabha, most powerfully near 3°. It gives emotional stability, contentment, love of comfort, beauty and the arts, and loyalty. It is classically a very fortunate Moon for peace of mind and wealth.

entries.title: Moon in Mithuna
entries.body: The Moon in Mercury's air sign gives a lively, curious, talkative and adaptable mind that needs variety and conversation. It favours learning and communication. Restlessness is the caution.

entries.title: Moon in Karka
entries.body: The Moon in its own sign is strong and nurturing. It gives deep emotional sensitivity, love of home and family, intuition and a caring nature. Security needs are strong and moods follow the tides.

entries.title: Moon in Simha
entries.body: The Moon in the Sun's fire sign is friendly. It gives a warm, proud and generous heart that needs appreciation, along with loyalty and dramatic emotional expression. Wounded pride is the sensitive spot.

entries.title: Moon in Kanya
entries.body: The Moon in Mercury's earth sign gives a practical, discerning, helpful and orderly mind. It suits service, health and analytical work. Worry and perfectionism need gentle handling.

entries.title: Moon in Tula
entries.body: The Moon in Venus's air sign gives a harmonious, social and fair-minded heart with refined taste. It needs partnership and balance. Decisions can waver out of a wish to please.

entries.title: Moon in Vrishchika
entries.body: The Moon is debilitated in Vrishchika, deepest near 3°. Feelings are intense, private and transformative, and the mind is prone to suspicion or emotional turbulence. Great psychological depth and resilience are possible. Neecha bhanga factors modify it.

entries.title: Moon in Dhanu
entries.body: The Moon in Jupiter's fire sign gives an optimistic, idealistic, freedom-loving heart devoted to principles, learning and travel. Honesty can be blunt, and faith supports emotional recovery.

entries.title: Moon in Makara
entries.body: The Moon in Saturn's earth sign gives a reserved, dutiful, practical heart. Emotions are controlled and expressed through responsibility. Ambition is steady, but warmth may need conscious cultivation.

entries.title: Moon in Kumbha
entries.body: The Moon in Saturn's air sign gives a detached, humanitarian, inventive mind that values friendship and ideals. Emotional expression may feel impersonal. Community work is fulfilling.

entries.title: Moon in Meena
entries.body: The Moon in Jupiter's water sign gives a compassionate, imaginative, spiritual and receptive heart, with an artistic or devotional nature. It is sensitive to surroundings and needs protective boundaries.

entries.title: Mars in Mesha
entries.body: Mars in its own sign and moolatrikona is strong and direct. It gives courage, initiative, athletic energy and leadership in action. Impatience and aggression need discipline.

entries.title: Mars in Vrishabha
entries.body: Mars in Venus's earth sign is neutral. It gives steady, determined energy for building resources and property. Passions are strong and persistent, and anger is slow to rise and slow to fade.

entries.title: Mars in Mithuna
entries.body: Mars in Mercury's air sign, an enemy sign, gives mental energy, argumentative skill and versatility, along with technical and communication drive. Energy can scatter, and words can be used as weapons.

entries.title: Mars in Karka
entries.body: Mars is debilitated in Karka, deepest near 28°. Action is coloured by emotion, and anger may be suppressed or erupt indirectly. It can give protective energy for home and family. Neecha bhanga factors can strengthen it.

entries.title: Mars in Simha
entries.body: Mars in the Sun's fire sign is friendly. It gives bold, commanding and generous energy suited to leadership, sport and the military. Pride can drive conflict.

entries.title: Mars in Kanya
entries.body: Mars in Mercury's earth sign, an enemy sign, gives precise, methodical, technical energy suited to engineering, surgery and analysis. It can be critical or fussy. Work is where its energy belongs.

entries.title: Mars in Tula
entries.body: Mars in Venus's air sign is neutral. It gives energy directed to partnerships, negotiation and justice. Assertiveness can alternate with accommodation, and desire is strong in relationships.

entries.title: Mars in Vrishchika
entries.body: Mars in its own water sign gives intense, strategic, secretive and resilient energy. It excels in research, surgery, investigation and crises. Grudges and control are the shadow.

entries.title: Mars in Dhanu
entries.body: Mars in Jupiter's fire sign is friendly. It gives energy in service of beliefs, adventure, sport and teaching. Zeal can become crusading, and it favours law and religious leadership.

entries.title: Mars in Makara
entries.body: Mars is exalted in Makara, most powerfully near 28°. Energy is disciplined, strategic and effective, with great capacity for sustained work, administration and engineering. It is classically among the strongest positions for achievement.

entries.title: Mars in Kumbha
entries.body: Mars in Saturn's air sign is neutral. It gives energy for causes, technology, innovation and group action. It can be rebellious or erratic, and suits engineering and social reform.

entries.title: Mars in Meena
entries.body: Mars in Jupiter's water sign is friendly. It gives compassionate, idealistic energy that is sometimes indirect. It favours service, healing, spiritual discipline and the arts. Motivation depends on meaning.

entries.title: Mercury in Mesha
entries.body: Mercury in Mars's fire sign gives a quick, decisive, outspoken mind with inventive and competitive thinking. Hasty speech or conclusions are the caution.

entries.title: Mercury in Vrishabha
entries.body: Mercury in Venus's earth sign, a friendly sign, gives practical, steady and pleasant speech with good business and financial sense. It learns slowly but retains well, and has an eye for aesthetics.

entries.title: Mercury in Mithuna
entries.body: Mercury in its own air sign is strong. It gives brilliant communication, wit, versatility and skill in writing, trade and languages. Nervousness and superficiality are the only cautions.

entries.title: Mercury in Karka
entries.body: Mercury in the Moon's water sign, an enemy sign by Mercury's reckoning, gives an intuitive and emotionally coloured intellect with a good memory. Thinking follows feeling, which suits storytelling, history and caregiving roles.

entries.title: Mercury in Simha
entries.body: Mercury in the Sun's fire sign is friendly. It gives confident, authoritative and dramatic communication, with skill in presentation and leadership of ideas. Pride in one's opinions is the caution.

entries.title: Mercury in Kanya
entries.body: Mercury is exalted in Kanya, most powerfully near 15°, which is also its moolatrikona and own sign. It gives analytical excellence, precision, skill in accounts, medicine, writing and science, and practical intelligence.

entries.title: Mercury in Tula
entries.body: Mercury in Venus's air sign is friendly. It gives diplomatic, balanced and refined communication with skill in negotiation, law, design and trade. Indecision is the watch-point.

entries.title: Mercury in Vrishchika
entries.body: Mercury in Mars's water sign is neutral. It gives a penetrating, investigative and secretive mind with skill in research, psychology and strategy. Words can be sharp.

entries.title: Mercury in Dhanu
entries.body: Mercury in Jupiter's fire sign is neutral. It gives a philosophical, broad-minded and teaching intellect, strong on big pictures and weaker on details. Speech is frank.

entries.title: Mercury in Makara
entries.body: Mercury in Saturn's earth sign, a friendly sign, gives a methodical, practical and structured intellect with skill in administration, accounts and planning. Its thinking is serious and it communicates cautiously.

entries.title: Mercury in Kumbha
entries.body: Mercury in Saturn's air sign is friendly. It gives an original, scientific and systems-oriented intellect suited to technology, research and social ideas. Thinking may be detached or unconventional.

entries.title: Mercury in Meena
entries.body: Mercury is debilitated in Meena, deepest near 15°. Logic yields to intuition and imagination. It can give poetic, spiritual or artistic thinking but less precision. Neecha bhanga factors and a strong Jupiter help greatly.

entries.title: Jupiter in Mesha
entries.body: Jupiter in Mars's fire sign is friendly. It gives energetic, pioneering wisdom, leadership in teaching or religion, and courage of conviction. Impatience with slower learners is the caution.

entries.title: Jupiter in Vrishabha
entries.body: Jupiter in Venus's earth sign, an enemy sign by classical friendship, gives practical wisdom, wealth-building and appreciation of comfort and culture. Growth is steady, with materialism to watch.

entries.title: Jupiter in Mithuna
entries.body: Jupiter in Mercury's air sign, an enemy sign, gives wide learning, curiosity and teaching through communication. Knowledge may be broad rather than deep, which suits writing and publishing.

entries.title: Jupiter in Karka
entries.body: Jupiter is exalted in Karka, most powerfully near 5°. It gives compassion, wisdom, protection, strong family values, prosperity and devotion. It is classically one of the most beneficial placements in the chart.

entries.title: Jupiter in Simha
entries.body: Jupiter in the Sun's fire sign is friendly. It gives dignified, generous, principled leadership and respect from others, and suits teaching, government and advisory roles.

entries.title: Jupiter in Kanya
entries.body: Jupiter in Mercury's earth sign, an enemy sign, gives practical, detail-oriented and service-minded wisdom suited to medicine, accounting and analysis. It can over-analyse matters of faith.

entries.title: Jupiter in Tula
entries.body: Jupiter in Venus's air sign, an enemy sign, gives wisdom applied to relationships, justice and diplomacy, and suits law and counselling. Balance between principle and pleasing others is its task.

entries.title: Jupiter in Vrishchika
entries.body: Jupiter in Mars's water sign is friendly. It gives deep, esoteric and transformative wisdom, interest in research and the occult, and resilience. It favours spiritual depth over conventional religion.

entries.title: Jupiter in Dhanu
entries.body: Jupiter in its own sign and moolatrikona is strong. It gives philosophical wisdom, righteousness, generosity, teaching, law and religious leadership. Fortune tends to be good.

entries.title: Jupiter in Makara
entries.body: Jupiter is debilitated in Makara, deepest near 5°. Faith and optimism are tested by practical demands, and wisdom becomes pragmatic. Growth can be slow, but structured achievement is possible. Neecha bhanga factors can make it powerful.

entries.title: Jupiter in Kumbha
entries.body: Jupiter in Saturn's air sign is neutral. It gives humanitarian, progressive and scientific wisdom and interest in social causes and group learning. Beliefs are unconventional.

entries.title: Jupiter in Meena
entries.body: Jupiter in its own water sign gives compassion, spirituality, devotion, intuition and generosity. It is classically a strong signature of wisdom and grace.

entries.title: Venus in Mesha
entries.body: Venus in Mars's fire sign is neutral. It gives passionate, impulsive and direct affection with bold aesthetic taste. Attraction is fast, and patience in love needs cultivating.

entries.title: Venus in Vrishabha
entries.body: Venus in its own earth sign is strong. It gives sensuality, love of comfort, beauty, music and food, steady affection and wealth-building. It is classically a very comfortable Venus.

entries.title: Venus in Mithuna
entries.body: Venus in Mercury's air sign is friendly. It gives playful, witty and social affection and artistic skill with words, music and design. Variety in romance is sought.

entries.title: Venus in Karka
entries.body: Venus in the Moon's water sign, an enemy sign, gives nurturing, sentimental and home-loving affection. Emotional security matters in love, and moods can affect relationships.

entries.title: Venus in Simha
entries.body: Venus in the Sun's fire sign, an enemy sign, gives generous, dramatic and proud affection with a love of luxury and admiration, and talent in the performing arts. Pride can strain romance.

entries.title: Venus in Kanya
entries.body: Venus is debilitated in Kanya, deepest near 27°. Affection is expressed through service and critique rather than romance, and satisfaction in love may be elusive. It gives skill in crafts and health professions. Neecha bhanga factors can ease it.

entries.title: Venus in Tula
entries.body: Venus in its own sign and moolatrikona is strong. It gives harmony, grace, diplomacy, refined taste and strong partnership instincts, and suits the arts, law and design.

entries.title: Venus in Vrishchika
entries.body: Venus in Mars's water sign is neutral. It gives intense, private and possessive passion and deep attachments, with loyalty and jealousy both strong. It can transform through love.

entries.title: Venus in Dhanu
entries.body: Venus in Jupiter's fire sign is neutral. It gives idealistic, adventurous and principled affection, with love of travel and culture and a need for freedom in relationships.

entries.title: Venus in Makara
entries.body: Venus in Saturn's earth sign is friendly. It gives loyal, practical and enduring affection, with love that matures with time, and aesthetic taste for the classic and structured.

entries.title: Venus in Kumbha
entries.body: Venus in Saturn's air sign is friendly. It gives friendly, unconventional and idealistic affection, values companionship and suits artistic innovation. It can seem detached in romance.

entries.title: Venus in Meena
entries.body: Venus is exalted in Meena, most powerfully near 27°. It gives devotional, compassionate and selfless love with great artistic, musical and spiritual refinement. It is classically among the finest placements for happiness in love.

entries.title: Saturn in Mesha
entries.body: Saturn is debilitated in Mesha, deepest near 20°. Patience clashes with the urge to act, bringing frustration, impulsive setbacks or conflict with authority. Discipline learned the hard way becomes real strength. Neecha bhanga factors modify it.

entries.title: Saturn in Vrishabha
entries.body: Saturn in Venus's earth sign, a friendly sign, gives steady, patient wealth-building, reliability and practical endurance. It is favourable for land, agriculture and finance.

entries.title: Saturn in Mithuna
entries.body: Saturn in Mercury's air sign is friendly. It gives a disciplined, structured intellect and serious study, and suits science, writing and technical communication. Worry is the watch-point.

entries.title: Saturn in Karka
entries.body: Saturn in the Moon's water sign, an enemy sign, gives emotional reserve, duty towards family and possible heaviness around home or the mother. Security is built slowly.

entries.title: Saturn in Simha
entries.body: Saturn in the Sun's fire sign, an enemy sign, can bring friction with authority or the father and a leadership earned through hardship. Pride has to meet humility.

entries.title: Saturn in Kanya
entries.body: Saturn in Mercury's earth sign is friendly. It gives methodical, meticulous, service-oriented work and suits health, accounts, analysis and crafts. Perfectionism and anxiety are the caution.

entries.title: Saturn in Tula
entries.body: Saturn is exalted in Tula, most powerfully near 20°. It gives justice, fairness, discipline in partnership and lasting achievement through balanced effort. It is classically one of Saturn's finest placements.

entries.title: Saturn in Vrishchika
entries.body: Saturn in Mars's water sign, an enemy sign, gives endurance through crises and deep, private discipline, and suits research and investigation. Emotional burdens can be carried silently.

entries.title: Saturn in Dhanu
entries.body: Saturn in Jupiter's fire sign is neutral. It gives structured beliefs, respect for tradition and a serious approach to dharma and teaching. Faith is tested and deepened.

entries.title: Saturn in Makara
entries.body: Saturn in its own earth sign is strong. It gives ambition, discipline, patience, organisational ability and a steady rise to authority through hard work.

entries.title: Saturn in Kumbha
entries.body: Saturn in its own sign and moolatrikona is strong. It gives humanitarian discipline, systems thinking and science, and service to society. Its approach is detached, principled and enduring.

entries.title: Saturn in Meena
entries.body: Saturn in Jupiter's water sign is neutral. It gives compassionate discipline, spiritual austerity and service in institutions or hospitals. Boundaries and practical structure need attention.

entries.title: Rahu in Mesha
entries.body: Rahu in Mars's fire sign amplifies ambition, independence and impulsive drive. It gives pioneering but restless energy and a hunger for being first. Channelled well, it breaks new ground.

entries.title: Rahu in Vrishabha
entries.body: Many traditions hold Rahu exalted in Vrishabha. It gives a strong drive for wealth, comfort and sensual pleasure, and can bring material success through unconventional means. Attachment to possessions is the caution.

entries.title: Rahu in Mithuna
entries.body: Rahu in Mercury's air sign, considered strong by some, amplifies curiosity, communication and cleverness, and suits media, technology and trade. Information overload and restlessness are the shadow.

entries.title: Rahu in Karka
entries.body: Rahu in the Moon's water sign amplifies emotional needs and attachment to home or belonging, which may bring restlessness about security or foreign residence. Emotional clarity is the work.

entries.title: Rahu in Simha
entries.body: Rahu in the Sun's fire sign amplifies the desire for recognition and power, and can give political ambition and a magnetic public image. Ego inflation is the caution.

entries.title: Rahu in Kanya
entries.body: Rahu in Mercury's earth sign, considered favourable by many, gives analytical ambition and success in technology, medicine, research and service industries. Anxiety over details needs managing.

entries.title: Rahu in Tula
entries.body: Rahu in Venus's air sign amplifies desire for partnership, beauty and social status, and suits law, diplomacy, fashion and trade. Relationships can be intense and unconventional.

entries.title: Rahu in Vrishchika
entries.body: Many hold Rahu debilitated in Vrishchika. It amplifies intensity, secrecy and hidden fears, and draws a person towards research, the occult and crisis work. Turbulence can become transformation.

entries.title: Rahu in Dhanu
entries.body: Rahu in Jupiter's fire sign amplifies the search for belief, foreign philosophies and travel. It can make a person question or reinvent tradition. Dogmatism in new beliefs is the caution.

entries.title: Rahu in Makara
entries.body: Rahu in Saturn's earth sign amplifies career ambition and the drive for status and structure, and can give success in large organisations or politics. Ethics must keep pace with ambition.

entries.title: Rahu in Kumbha
entries.body: Rahu in Saturn's air sign, traditionally comfortable, amplifies innovation, technology, networks and unconventional social ideas. It favours science and large groups.

entries.title: Rahu in Meena
entries.body: Rahu in Jupiter's water sign amplifies imagination, spiritual longing and escapism, and suits film, art, foreign spiritual traditions and charity. Confusion and addictive patterns are the caution.

entries.title: Ketu in Mesha
entries.body: Ketu in Mars's fire sign gives instinctive courage and past-life martial skill, with sudden, detached action. It can act without ego, or with disregard for consequences.

entries.title: Ketu in Vrishabha
entries.body: Many hold Ketu debilitated in Vrishabha. It gives detachment from material comfort and possessions, with fluctuating finances. Simplicity and spiritual values bring contentment.

entries.title: Ketu in Mithuna
entries.body: Ketu in Mercury's air sign gives an intuitive rather than logical intellect, with gaps in formal learning but flashes of insight. Communication can be terse or unusual.

entries.title: Ketu in Karka
entries.body: Ketu in the Moon's water sign gives emotional detachment, a sense of not belonging at home, and deep intuition. Spiritual peace replaces the need for external security.

entries.title: Ketu in Simha
entries.body: Ketu in the Sun's fire sign gives detachment from recognition and ego and a quiet inner authority. Past-life leadership may manifest without the wish for status.

entries.title: Ketu in Kanya
entries.body: Ketu in Mercury's earth sign gives intuitive analysis and skill in healing or detailed technical work, done without attachment. Anxiety can be released through service.

entries.title: Ketu in Tula
entries.body: Ketu in Venus's air sign gives detachment in partnerships and unconventional relationships. Balance is sought within rather than through others.

entries.title: Ketu in Vrishchika
entries.body: Many traditions hold Ketu exalted in Vrishchika. It gives deep occult insight, research, spiritual transformation and fearlessness in the face of the hidden. It is a strong position for moksha.

entries.title: Ketu in Dhanu
entries.body: Ketu in Jupiter's fire sign, considered strong by some, gives intuitive spiritual wisdom and detachment from dogma. Faith comes from direct experience rather than doctrine.

entries.title: Ketu in Makara
entries.body: Ketu in Saturn's earth sign gives detachment from worldly ambition or status. Career paths may be unusual or change suddenly, and work is done for its own sake.

entries.title: Ketu in Kumbha
entries.body: Ketu in Saturn's air sign gives detachment from groups and social validation and an original, independent intelligence. It is spiritually inclined towards universal ideals.

entries.title: Ketu in Meena
entries.body: Ketu in Jupiter's water sign is traditionally favourable for spirituality, giving meditation, intuition, compassion and liberation. Worldly boundaries may feel thin.
